name: arena-countdown
description: Button starts a 3-second countdown; a repeat clock advances one second at a time, shows 3/2/1/GO, then switches the arena to running state.

blocks.command: execute if score fb_tick arena matches 20.. run scoreboard players set fb_tick arena 0
blocks.note: succeeds only on the wrap tick, so the rest runs once per second
one-second flag: display blocks run unconditionally but gate on this

blocks.command: execute if score fb_second arena matches 1 if score fb_state arena matches 1 if score fb_count arena matches 3 run title @a title §e3
execute if score fb_second arena matches 1 if score fb_state arena matches 1 if score fb_count arena matches 2 run title @a title §e2
execute if score fb_second arena matches 1 if score fb_state arena matches 1 if score fb_count arena matches 1 run title @a title §e1
execute if score fb_second arena matches 1 if score fb_state arena matches 1 if score fb_count arena matches 0 run title @a title §aGO!
execute if score fb_second arena matches 1 if score fb_state arena matches 1 if score fb_count arena matches 0 run scoreboard players set fb_state arena 2
execute if score fb_second arena matches 1 if score fb_state arena matches 1 if score fb_count arena matches 1.. run scoreboard players remove fb_count arena 1
blocks.note: decrement after displaying, so 3 is visible for a full second
must be unconditional so it also runs when the countdown path was skipped
next tick wraps the clock so 3 appears immediately

tests: Press start once: 3, 2, 1, GO appear one second apart.
Press start twice quickly: countdown restarts at 3 without skipping.
Press reset during countdown: title clears and state returns to idle.
Two players online: both see the same countdown titles.
Leave and rejoin during countdown: state stays consistent.
notes: The fb_second flag is the key: display blocks are unconditional, so they run every tick, but the flag gates them to one second.
If you prefer fewer blocks, titleraw with a score component can show fb_count directly.
